name: code-cat
description: A cute white cat that lives in your editor, treating code as a platformer terrain

codeCat.catColor.description: Cat color in hex (e.g. #ffffff for white, #ff9900 for orange). Paw prints will match.

codeCat.idleTimeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before Code Cat appears in the editor

codeCat.sleepTime.description: Seconds the cat sleeps after finishing one fish session before the next session begins

codeCat.fishSessionCount.description: Number of consecutive fish the cat chases before it goes to sleep

codeCat.animationSpeed.description: Animation speed multiplier applied to running, jumping, falling, and chase timing (0.5 = slow, 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = fast)

codeCat.showFootprints.description: Show paw print trail behind the cat while running

scripts.package:vsix: npm run compile && npx vsce package
